scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/protocol && tsc --noEmit -p packages/client && tsc --noEmit -p apps/host && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web && tsc --noEmit -p apps/server && tsc --noEmit -p apps/cli && tsc --noEmit -p apps/desktop && tsc --noEmit -p apps/site
scripts.test: vitest run && cargo test && cargo test -p pinomad-core --features ffi
scripts.build: cd apps/web && bun run build && cd ../site && bun run build
scripts.desktop: cd apps/desktop && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE= bun run dev
scripts.desktop:package: cd apps/desktop && bun run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false bunx electron-builder
scripts.desktop:e2e: cd apps/desktop && bun run build && node test/e2e.ts
